# FX volatility surface: fx-vol-surface (FXV)

Implied vols by expiry and delta (ATM, 25D RR/BF). One row per fx volatility surface per business date, keyed by SURFACE_ID. Read by the **market-data** pack's connector `market-store` (table `<root>/market/fx-vol-surface/`). Delivered **daily**, 60 business days (2026-07-08 to 2026-09-30): the first day's file is a **full snapshot** (12 records); the records never changed over the period, so every later day's file is empty. Drishti applies a day's file by key over the day before: a record absent from a day's file keeps its previous version, and nothing is ever deleted (an end is a changed status). 12 rows in all.

## File layout

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Path | `data/testdata/market-data/fx-vol-surface/` + `changes-YYYY-MM-DD.jsonl.gz`, `snapshot-YYYY-MM-DD.jsonl.gz` |
| Format | JSON Lines: UTF-8, one JSON object a line, gzip-compressed (`.jsonl.gz`) |
| Key field | `SURFACE_ID` |
| Date field | none in the record: the business date is the file's date (`snapshot-` or `changes-YYYY-MM-DD`), which becomes the lake's partition `business_date` |
| Promoted columns | none (the whole record is kept as `doc`) |
| Vector fields | none |
| Partitioned by | `business_date` |
| A day's file | a full snapshot on the first day, then only the changed records |

## Field reference

Every field of the record above, nested ones as dotted paths (`[]` marks an array of objects). *Required* is the contract's; *in N%* is how often the test data fills it.

| Field | Type | Required | Meaning | Values, format, unit | Example |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `SURFACE_ID` | string | required | The record's id (the business key) | pattern `^FXV-` | `"FXV-AUDUSD"` |
| `PAIR` | string | required | The currency pair, base then quote currency, six letters (AUDUSD). | — | `"AUDUSD"` |
| `ATM_1M` | number | required | The 1-month at-the-money implied volatility, in percent a year. | unit: percent | `9.17` |
| `ATM_1Y` | number | required | The 1-year at-the-money implied volatility, in percent a year. | unit: percent | `9.9` |
| `RR_1Y` | number | required | The 1-year 25-delta risk reversal: the 25-delta call volatility minus the 25-delta put volatility, in volatility points. | unit: vol points | `-0.46` |
| `GRID` | array of objects | required | The surface: one object per expiry, shortest first, quoted by delta. | — | [6 objects] |
| `GRID[].EXPIRY` | string | required | The option expiry of the row (1M, 3M … 5Y). | one of `1M`, `1Y`, `2Y`, `3M`, `5Y`, `6M` | `"1M"` |
| `GRID[].P_10` | number | required | The 10-delta put implied volatility, in percent a year. | unit: percent | `10.04` |
| `GRID[].P_25` | number | required | The 25-delta put implied volatility, in percent a year. | unit: percent | `9.6` |
| `GRID[].ATM` | number | required | The at-the-money implied volatility, in percent a year. | unit: percent | `9.17` |
| `GRID[].C_25` | number | required | The 25-delta call implied volatility, in percent a year. | unit: percent | `9.24` |
| `GRID[].C_10` | number | required | The 10-delta call implied volatility, in percent a year. | unit: percent | `9.4` |
| `GRID[].RR_25` | number | required | The 25-delta risk reversal at the expiry: call vol minus put vol, in vol points. | unit: vol points | `-0.36` |
| `GRID[].BF_25` | number | required | The 25-delta butterfly at the expiry: average of the 25-delta wings minus ATM, in vol points. | unit: vol points | `0.25` |
| `MODEL` | string | required | The smile model and quoting of the surface (e.g. Vanna-volga smile, delta-quoted). | — | `"Vanna-volga smile, delta-quoted"` |
| `FX_SPOT` | string | required | The pair's spot record: a PAIR of the market-data pack's fx-spot kind (FX-…). | pattern `^FX-`; links to `fx-spot` | `"FX-AUDUSD"` |

## Fields in other rows

None: all 12 rows were read, and every field any of them has is in the record above.

## For the production query

- **Identity:** one record per `SURFACE_ID` per `business_date`; the key is text, unique within the date.
- **Never null:** `SURFACE_ID`, `PAIR`, `ATM_1M`, `ATM_1Y`, `RR_1Y`, `GRID`, `MODEL`, `FX_SPOT` (the contract's required fields).
- **Format:** JSON Lines, UTF-8, one object a line, gzip; field names exactly as shown (UPPER_SNAKE); dates `YYYY-MM-DD`; numbers as JSON numbers, never strings; a missing value is `null` or absent (an empty string is read as empty).
- **Arrays:** keep the order shown (vectors in the scenario set's or the run's order); nested objects as JSON, never flattened.
- Each day: the records new or changed that day (or all of them); Drishti keeps the rest from the day before.
- Unique: `SURFACE_ID` per business_date.
- `SURFACE_ID` matches `^FXV-`.
